description:
Most people overestimate what they can do in a year and they underestimate what they can do in two or three decades. ⏳

Date With Destiny has long been where people redesign life on their terms. 💫

In 2016, I Am Not Your Guru opened a window into that experience. Tomorrow we kick off our 90th Date With Destiny, built on the collective journey of people choosing to create life on their terms and claim their destiny. ✨❤️

If you have attended Date With Destiny before or you will be joining us over the next 6 days, let me know below. 👇
